notes: Nine complete off-to-on-to-off episodes are visible. The hinged bedroom entry door is opened around frame 1480 but has no supported return to closed before the sequence ends, so it is treated as traversal rather than a complete interaction episode. The two independently moving pantry cabinet leaves are reported separately; their rapid closing occurs while the camera turns away, making their individual off timings less certain.
scene_description: Wide-angle apartment walkthrough progressing through the kitchen, living area, utility and laundry closets, and bedroom.
